title: getprojectspubliccontentretrieval
description: Test GET /api/projects endpoint without authentication to verify it returns 200 status with a list of projects and that the response data correctly renders project cards with external links.

title: getskillsandexperiencecontentdisplay
description: Test GET /api/skills and GET /api/experience endpoints without authentication to ensure they return 200 status with categorized skills and timeline entries, and that the data displays correctly in the public UI.

title: postcontactformsubmissionvalidation
description: Test POST /api/contact endpoint with valid and invalid payloads to verify form validation, successful message persistence, email notification sending, and proper error handling when email service fails.

title: postadminauthlogin
description: Test POST /api/auth/login with valid and invalid admin credentials to confirm successful JWT token issuance on valid login and proper 401 unauthorized response on invalid login attempts.

title: postadminprojectsmanagement
description: Test POST, PUT, DELETE /api/admin/projects endpoints with valid JWT tokens to verify creation, updating, and deletion of projects, and confirm changes reflect in public GET /api/projects responses.

title: getadmincontactmessagesmanagement
description: Test GET and PATCH /api/admin/contact-messages endpoints with valid JWT tokens to ensure retrieval of contact inquiries and updating their status, and verify 401/403 responses when unauthorized.

title: poststaticassetuploads
description: Test POST /api/uploads endpoint with valid JWT and multipart file data to confirm successful file uploads and URL return, and test rejection of unsupported file types, oversized files, and unauthorized requests.
